Featuring rare concert footage, never-before-seen archives of Ka Kui's early years, and unreleased work, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of Wong Ka Kui- not through nostalgia, not as a distant legend, but as he truly was. At its heart is the precious legacy of his character and convictions—one that continues to transcend generations, his music still lifting spirits and inspiring hope today.

title: OK.FINE.
overview: Eight-year-old Xiao Ru lives in a perfect world, blessed with a hilarious father and a caring mother. But when her phone unexpectedly breaks, it sets off a solo journey to get it fixed. On this adventure, she not only faces the unknown but also stumbles upon a cruel truth she was never meant to discover.

title: PLEASE
overview: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.

title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

title: For Séamus
overview: Set in rural Ireland, For Séamus explores the silent struggles between fathers and sons, revealing a story of reconciliation, legacy, and love left unspoken.

title: Onekdin Por
overview: Framed as a river between two banks, the story follows a young woman balancing her home life and the elderly care center where she works, connected by her daily bus ride. As she forms a quiet bond with a fellow passenger, the lives of the aging residents reveal themes of loneliness, friendship, and the growing distance between generations.

title: YURIE
overview: ​​Three years have passed since Joji Uehara lost his father and took over his eatery "Yurie". Despite Joji's impressive culinary skills, his business continues to dwindle. One day, Kim Joo-ri, who came from South Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, arrives at the restaurant by coincidence. Although they clash over their differing values, the two of them gradually become closer as they work together to revive the struggling business. Guided by Kim's charmingly unconventional approach to life, the people around her begin to break free from their rigid minds.

title: Life Coach
overview: A lonely Muay Thai instructor (Mark Bale) seeks self-confidence through an online life-coaching app, gradually surrendering control to an unseen mentor.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: in:CUBE
overview: Consumed by self-imposed isolation and total apathy, a young man’s mind begins to violently turn against him, trapping him in a psychological puzzle box of his own making where he must fight his own fractured identities to survive.

title: Где ты?
overview: Maks and Anna's lives are destroyed by the theft of their only three-month-old child. Six years later, Anna finds the strength to start living again, and Maks does not give up and continues to search for his son.

title: 2026 SVT 10TH FAN MEETING 〈SEVENTEEN in CARAT LAND〉
overview: Seventeen's 10th fan meeting took place at INCHEON ASIAD MAIN STADIUM in Incheon, South Korea from June 20-21, 2026, both in-person and online.

title: Under the Olive Tree
overview: A young shepherd returns home after the Second World War having been held in a prisoner of war camp. He finds that the local landowner has stolen his sheep and his girlfriend. When he also assaults and murders his sister, the shepherd takes revenge.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: After the death of his mother, a young boy leaves his home in grief, believing that only by finding God can he meet her again. His search takes him across temples, forests, rivers and villages, where he lives in silence, discipline and devotion, slowly shedding all attachments. Through years of wandering and inner struggle, he discovers that God is not found in escape from the world, but in serving it. As his compassion grows, so do stories of quiet miracles, healing, and grace. Renouncing identity and ownership, the boy transforms into Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba, dedicating his life to feeding the hungry, loving all without distinction, and blessing humanity through humility, service and silent faith.

title: All the Things I Leave You
overview: At a family-run restaurant in Ilocos, Jorge, a privileged young man, is forced to work alongside Kiko, a street-smart newcomer hired by Jorge's grandfather, Tino, a retired sakada. When Tino suddenly dies, the two discover a hidden cigar box filled with unsent letters and photographs that reveal a decades-old love story between Tino and his best friend, Bong - a bond shaped by migration, forgetting, and sacrifice. As Jorge and Kiko piece together this lost history, their own relationship begins to shift. Set across generations and rooted in Ilokano culture, the series is a quiet exploration of class, intimacy, and the legacies we inherit - and choose to carry forward.

title: Camp Oleander
overview: Camp Oleander promises transformation, but its idyllic surface masks a ritual of conversion designed to strip away memory, desire, and queerness. Parker and Laura’s connection blooms, tender and forbidden, and threatened by the camp’s most seductive rite.

title: A Stab At Heaven
overview: A true story of an 18-year-old Ema McKie who, after receiving news that her fiancé has committed suicide, drives across the country to join him in death, losing her mind to find her truth and journey home.

title: Car Crashes
overview: A Tinder date over cheap pizza devolves into a shit show.

title: Reminiscence of a Moviegoer
overview: For Reminiscence of a Moviegoer, filmmaker Christiane Büchner works extensive interviews with the late Werner Dütsch, a commissioning editor at the German television station WDR, and massively influential figure in postwar West German film culture, into a moving portrait of cinephilia through time.

title: Распаковка
overview: Popular blogger Vlad tries to attract attention to his concert in an original way - he puts himself up for auction. The lot immediately goes to the son of a rich businessman. Now Vlad is obliged to entertain Borya for a whole week. All attempts to break the contract run into huge fines, and then Vlad decides to really piss off Borya and make a video blog out of his life. In response, Borya arranges more and more new challenges for him.

title: Blue Lullaby
overview: A young girl retraces her relationship with her mother while they bake a pie together. Until she starts to remember what she seemed to have forgotten.

title: The Lovers
overview: Sara Lim Baylon , a reluctant seafood chef from Binondo, Manila. As the youngest member of her family to run their restaurant, Sara faces the daunting pressure to live up to her late father's reputation and keep the business afloat. When the governor's inauguration dinner is planned at the restaurant, featuring a sirena as the centerpiece, Sara finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair with the mythical creature.

title: Rescued
overview: A homeless man finds the motivation to turn his life around after a stray dog saves his life and refuses to leave his side.

title: Goodbye to All That
overview: In a dusty apartment, Gabo mourns the end of a difficult relationship. Soon, reality gives way to a dreamlike delirium…

title: Truly Mine
overview: Leila, an 18-year-old girl who is on the brink of adulthood. As the pressure of her family's expectations grows, Leila has to choose between a life laid out for her or freedom, risking everything she loves for a life that's truly hers.

title: Le Temps d'une Tartine 2
overview: While Mixel tries the best he can to help along with Martin's parents, Charlène and Martin have escaped the flames and appeared somewhen else, where twists and turns won't end. Why is everything happening? To find that out... they must go Back to the Toaster!

title: Headline
overview: One headline, countless questions, and the fight for a single truth. What lies hidden behind the overnight changed story?

title: ELEFANTE
overview: Maria reunites with her friend Eliza after a long time, however, the discomfort and tension between them quickly grow when the topic of Eliza's pregnancy comes up.

title: Modem
overview: A digital detox vacation goes wrong when a teenager discovers a MODEM.

title: What's That Smell?
overview: A fictional documentary following the exploits of Hank, a Los Angeles plumber going through a bitter divorce who decides he's going to clean up his city... by killing every homeless person he can find.

title: Night in the Valley of Witches
overview: This film is set in the Valley of the Witches area within Ghibli Park and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli specifically for the park.

title: Lorie Party 2025/2026
overview: Lorie invites you to a colorful and festive evening! Hear all her greatest hits during her Lorie Party 2025/2026 tour!

title: On a Stringer
overview: At noon, in the shade of riverside trees — as if in the middle of life — you lose something. Yet love is as strong as the river. A man is going through abrupt changes in his life — both personal and caused by the war. He spends a day alone by the river, revisiting a forgotten hobby — fishing. A sense of love and acceptance fills him, but only for a brief moment — he must return to the war.

title: Samson and Delilah
overview: A young woman working in an elite nightclub uses her beauty and intelligence to exploit and steal from wealthy customers.

title: ترايثليت
overview: A triathlete living and training in Al-Naseem district, exploring how the sport becomes more than just competition, but a way of life built on discipline, endurance, and commitment. Through his daily routine and personal journey, the film highlights the challenges of pursuing an intense sport while balancing everyday life, offering a closer look at ambition and perseverance within an unexpected environment.

title: Saving Spoonie
overview: Spoonie, the spoon-billed sandpiper, would have long since gone extinct without Dr. Christoph Zöckler and a tight-knit group of international ornithologists. As if that weren’t bad enough, the migration route of this sparrow-sized wading bird—with its peculiar spoon-shaped bill—runs from Russia through North Korea and China all the way to Myanmar, passing through several of the world’s crisis regions of the past decade. The work of the task force is therefore also a political challenge. It requires diplomatic sensitivity in coordinating with the countries along the flyway. In the tragicomic story of Spoonie’s fate, the struggle for threatened biodiversity in an increasingly fragile world is reflected.

title: Her First Taste
overview: Wen Yuwen, a cute and naive high school girl, loves Chinese far more than math. She tentatively steps into billiard halls, clothing stores and hotels — places of the adult world. She also begins to confront growing pains: relationships with the opposite sex, studying abroad, and her father’s infidelity. Confused yet brave at times, she embarks on a stumbling adventure of youth.

title: Benigno
overview: There are people who spend their entire lives in the same house, their childhood home where their family history rests. Benigno, at eighty-eight years old, still sleeps, eats, and dreams in the home where he was born, the home that is rooted in the earth to reach for the sky. The house stands alone, alongside Benigno and his tortoise Totó, adrift in the limbo of memories, the ritual of daily life, and the anticipation of the final day. Adjacent to the house is his vegetable garden, which he visits daily to tend to his chickens and work the soil with the seeds inherited from his ancestors, which he ceremoniously catalogs and preserves.

title: The Smile Everyone Loved
overview: Sometimes it's hard to be someone who everyone loves.

title: Youthful Grace
overview: Amir and Eliyahu, two teens living on the outskirts of Jerusalem, try to survive in a world of adult neglect. An unusual encounter on Passover Eve leads them on an unexpected journey.

title: They Slay
overview: Longtime friends Raemee, Maggie and Lee come together for an annual Halloween hang-out at Lee’s house. Things are different this year when Maggie's new partner, Sam, and Lee’s younger sibling, Charlie, join the group. When they reignite their tradition of playing with a spirit board, they accidentally invite a supernatural being to join in the party. Uncomfortable truths rise to the surface and things take a dark turn, calling into question if the friendships will survive the night- or if the friends will survive at all.

title: Fifth Mission
overview: A methodical hitman kills those he believes are beyond justice. When a detective whose brother he murdered begins to hunt him, the chase becomes personal, blurring the line between law, revenge, and morality, and asking how far justice can bend before it is justice no more?

title: All in light ebbed aside
overview: Started as a filmdiary, “Ogni cosa nella luce si ritrae” is an attempt at assembling all the footage shot over the course of thirteen months through a logic capable of showing both its intimacy and distance. A hendiadys turned towards its incompleteness, towards the margin itself (here, each time: the film leader, the cut that links and separates the images), always and yet never entirely continuous/discontinuous, at the same time.

title: GƎNƎSIS
overview: Eva, raised in an artificial Eden to obey the voice of a god who controls her, discovers a message revealing that her world is a carefully constructed lie. Driven by her need for freedom, she must challenge the system to escape the only place she has ever known.

title: Traveling Alone
overview: Misaki, who has worked in Tokyo for ten years, spends quality time with her family and friends again in her hometown. At an event where classmates gather, she learns that the boy she liked in middle school has died.

title: Chance
overview: Inspired by historical events, this episodic film explores the role of chance in human life and death.

title: Revelations
overview: Nuca, one of the world’s leading bee specialists, celebrates her birthday surrounded by family traditions. As the family matriarch, time is relentless in its toll on her memory loss. In an attempt to remember, she revisits family photographs, and as the past and present intertwine, secrets begin to surface. At this celebration, it won't just be the photos that are revealed.

title: Morir no siempre sale bien
overview: Rosario's husband and brother are out of work after being unfairly dismissed. To pay off their debts, they decide to kidnap their boss's body and demand a ransom. But Inés, the wealthy wife of the deceased, and her children have other plans. Despite belonging to completely different worlds, the two families will be forced to exchange much more than a body.

title: Hospital Británico
overview: A man leaves the hospital. He sets out on a journey, perhaps a final one. Alongside the mystical landscapes drift the verses of Hospital Británico (1986), the last book by Héctor Viel Temperley. And the words of those who have been marked by reading it over the years.

title: Big Break
overview: When three Los Angeles transplants discover that the MiniDV tape containing their drunken shenanigans is missing, they revisit their sins from the night prior in order to recover the secrets they’ve recorded.

title: Short Sharp Scares: Teraphobia
overview: Fear isn't always irrational.

title: Best Friends
overview: Robert doesn’t wake, dress, or even shave without the help of his best friends, Ewa and Adam. He has outsourced his whole existence, delegating every practical and emotional detail of his life. As the day of a career-defining interview unfolds, subtle cracks begin to appear. Faced with a situation that demands independence, Robert starts to question not only his own abilities, but also how much of himself he has already surrendered.

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: Watched
overview: After her boyfriend Logan begins acting suspicious, Rachel becomes aware that her reality is hiding something a little more sinister.

title: The Glimmering
overview: A man who studies Mongolian history enjoys happy life with his wife. But one day after the president declares martial law, he loses his wife in a sudden accident. Struck by the immense shock, he loses his ability to speak. Now, the man must find his voice again in order to speak with the spirit of his departed wife.

title: Overcooked
overview: Alex Angelo Albano, a youthful chef, stuggles with his work life taking over his whole life...

title: This House of Ours
overview: An elderly woman copes with the aftermath of her husband's death by locking herself up inside their family home and holding onto their daily rituals, all the while being pulled into different directions by the pressure from their children.

title: Valencia - Chapter I
overview: One December night, Alice works as a babysitter while the baby's parents go out for the night. As time passes and the night deepens, she begins to receive chilling threats from a man who seems to be watching her from every blind spot in the darkness.

title: Bliss: Beyond the Edge of Time
overview: Six animation directors draw on the six lines of the I Ching to create distinct shorts rooted in Taiwanese vernacular culture. Blending tradition and futurity, faith and emotion, and science fiction with reality, these intersecting visions spiral toward a cold, fantastical romance in an animated void reminiscent of Black Mirror.

title: Para atrapar el viento
overview: A man chases a rebellious gust of wind across the hills as it creates chaos and music through the grassland.

title: The Saturn Code
overview: When a kid is assigned a conspiracy theory project, he goes in too deep to a conspiracy about Saturn, forever changing his life.

title: I Am a DVD Player
overview: A love story between a fisherman and a DVD player.

title: Donnie & Dude: Do Dudley
overview: When two stoners go on a journey from Sedgley to a charity shop in Dudley, they run into trouble with a sergeant and his special “Anti-Weed Task Force” (A.W.T.F) When they finally get a copy of a dvd from the charity shop, a mysterious evil character called “Gimp Man” comes to take it from them. With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

title: Ganibarra
overview: What happens when we lose a species that is family? Ganibarra is a deeply personal journey into the cultural connection between first nations people and dingoes.

title: Palimpsest: The Story of a Name
overview: Veteran filmmaker Mary Stephen digs into her own family past to uncover the long-hidden origins of her Western surname, revealing a story of culture shock, colonialism, and contested remembrance.

title: The Crucian
overview: Born never to cry, Fish seeks his missing mother through the underworld. He believes her ghost is imprisoned within a deity puppet — yet, it conceals neither his mother nor an informant, but a survivor. Through the puppet’s mouth, the seaside street’s buried past unfolds.

title: JE VEUX FAIRE UN FILM ABSTRAIT !
overview: Émile, a cinema student at Janot High School, must make a short-film for his film studies diploma. To carry out his project, he needs to form a group with some of his classmates, with whom he will be confronted, given the rather strange nature of his project...

title: Are You Human?
overview: On a mysterious game show a young woman is forced to prove herself more human than her competitor.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: An apocalyptic nightmare about war and destruction, set to the Allegro from Shostakovich' 10th symphony.

title: I Am The Bride
overview: On The Death's Curve there's a legend: at 3:00 a.m. a bride dressed in white appears, waiting for her next victim. A detective teams up with a priest, a paranormal investigator, and a medium, to bring an end to this puzzle.

title: Palm
overview: In South Los Angeles, a palm tree caretaker faces the quiet unraveling of his work and identity.

title: Flame
overview: When an artist stages a deeply personal performance piece, her work becomes an urgent attempt to reach her audience before it's too late.

title: Hope is Hip
overview: In a seaside town, a group of young skateboarders finds themselves in a feud with a neighbor when their local skatepark is threatened with closure.

title: Luna
overview: With the moon hurtling toward Earth and the world unraveling, one woman's quiet descent into solitude mirrors the chaos above.  As doomsday approaches, Selene-adrift in grief and silence-finds an unexpected connection in the sky's slow collapse. A haunting, poetic journey through memory and meaning, The Award winning Luna is a meditative tale of endings, and the peace we find when we stop running from them.

title: Company Sports Day
overview: Sales Team 3 is made the scapegoat for the chairman's embezzlement scandal. The team leader attempts to reveal the truth, but the manipulation of evidence by a key executive pushes the entire team to the brink of collective dismissal.

title: The Social Distance
overview: In an attempt to make the most of their limited fun during the summer of the  Covid-19 lockdown, a science nerd and her boy-crazy best friend decide to build  a spaceship to escape the quarantine before the summer ends and they start at  different highschools, but as the lift-off draws near, they find that building a  rocket may prove easier than maintaining their friendship.

title: Infinity Mirror
overview: During a tense encounter in a bar bathroom, Bash gets trapped in a time loop with his ex-best friend—and his only hope of escape is to confront what tore them apart.

title: Black Annis
overview: Following a personal tragedy, Ann becomes aware of an eerie presence stalking her every move, as frightening changes begin to occur.

title: The Troll
overview: A TikTok megastar spirals after one cruel comment, stalking her troll in a descent that blurs fame, obsession, and revenge.

title: Love & Other Crimes
overview: Noah Thomas's life takes a dangerous turn when a chance reunion with an old high school friend entangles him in a ruthless crime ring. As he falls deeper into the syndicate's violent world, his budding romance with Shaye Matthews offers a fragile glimmer of hope. Torn between love and survival, Noah must navigate betrayals, escalating stakes, and deadly choices that threaten to destroy everything he values.

title: Afterblue
overview: A boy wakes up confused in an enchanting forest, when a butterfly calms him and guides him through the woods to an ethereal garden, where he encounters a mysterious carp that takes him on an astral journey of liberation.

title: High Voltage
overview: Over the course of a single night in the Far Rockaways, two teenage girls drift toward an intimacy that neither can fully name, blurring the line between friendship and desire.

title: Fennel
overview: During a tense lunch, a father and son struggle to connect. Fennel is a quiet, intimate look at the emotional distance between parent and child and the words left unsaid.

title: Hunter's Moon
overview: After a successful season in the Upper Dhauladhar Mountains, a hunter hides his meat in a cave and heads home with his first load. At home, his wife is upset over his prolonged absence and its impact on their disabled daughter. He promises to return quickly and the next morning, sets out to retrieve the rest of the meat and leave the forest for the season. To his dismay, he finds the cave empty and the meat stolen. Using his hunter instincts he launches a desperate search through the  treacherous mountain, discovering that the rival is just as cunning. In this quest for meat, humans behave no differently than wild animals. Battling harsh conditions and difficult terrains, they go to all extremes to prove themselves stronger and more deserving. This allegorical tale of conflicting morals and twisted values reveals the true nature of man in the wild.

title: The Kalgan Horse
overview: In the borderlands of farming and herding in northern China, a Mongolian horse awaits the fate of castration, while a 10-year-old boy, determined to protect it, must confront violence and cruelty beyond his understanding.

title: Cruising Lesbiana
overview: Select characters from Barcelona's flinta community sit in a driving car and and talk about cruising, desire and different forms of spaces. Rough HDV material and selected images draw on the city of Barcelona and a fictional narrative of a cab driver who explores various forms of cruising areas, creating an experimental docu-fiction narrative.

title: Grim Reaper Barber
overview: A hairdresser who is increasingly frustrated with things not going well slips on the stairs. When she wakes up, she is led by a rookie grim reaper to a mysterious beauty salon, where grim reaper hairdressers give makeovers to the deceased to help them in their final goodbyes.

title: The Producer
overview: Tom, a young ambitious producer starts spiralling three years into his career when he begins hearing voices and seeing himself in ways that frighten him.

title: Laws Of Desire
overview: Angel is a young woman on the brink of a nervous breakdown. Feeling as if she has no control left in her life, she commits wholeheartedly to a series of spontaneous and erratic decisions. The result is an emotional metamorphosis with large scale consequences.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: About the Dream to Be Unsinkable
overview: The film traces the rise  and fall of GDR deep-sea fishing fleet - and the afterlives of its last surviving ships. Once more than a hundred strong, only a few vessels remain, now under new names, with new missions and new dreams: repurposed as rescue boats, cultural platforms, or sound spaces.

title: Lenin's Pawn
overview: LENIN’S PAWN is a hybrid documentary with dark humor following actor Sergiu Voloc, a modern-day Don Quixote whose lonely fight against Lenin monuments across Moldova turns into an absurd confrontation with a system that rebuilds them overnight.

title: Downtown
overview: In 1988, three young gay men, Ronnie, Lennart and Bas, throw themselves into Amsterdam's nightlife  scene. It’s a life full of friendship, sex and drugs. Until the mysterious AIDS virus casts a shadow over their  lives and one of them disappears after becoming infected. Thirty-two years later, in the middle of the 2021  lockdown, Ronnie recognises the missing Bas in the subway. An evening unfolds that none of them had  expected to see, but which had been in the air for years. The AIDS epidemic has had a major impact on all  three of their lives. Where they lost each other 32 years ago, they hope to find each other again.

title: Pass the Salt
overview: Alexander Watson a working detective. Is searching for a recent missing person named Jack Davidson. A family invites him to dinner to discuss information they might know, to help solve the case.

title: Wake
overview: As the sun rises, an old man awakens.

title: Make Sense
overview: Michelin-star-winning master chef Michael Bringalow adds an autumnal soup to his menu.

title: SOS Save Our Students
overview: A young trainee teacher begins his journey into the teaching profession with hopes and ideals. His convictions are put to the test when he finds himself caught in an emotional triangle involving a female student and a male LGBTQ+ student, both deeply devoted to him. As affection turns into an increasingly complicated bond, he must confront difficult choices between professional responsibility and personal emotions.

title: WILF - Hope & Hardship
overview: In WW1 Germany, Australian citizens are pronounced 'Enemy Aliens', and their lives and whereabouts are controlled by the authorities. Wilf is taken from his University and placed on a rural farm, and then later imprisoned along with other foreigners as the war rages on across Europe.

title: Gone and Taken
overview: After his brother Jack is kidnapped, Ethan risks everything to track him down. Following clues to a remote house, he faces deadly danger in a desperate attempt to bring Jack home. As time runs out, their mother launches a frantic search, unaware of the nightmare unfolding.

title: Restless
overview: After losing his parents in an accident, Jason Gaterson slowly begins going crazy

title: The Class: Online
overview: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

title: Rising Embers
overview: Two thousand years. One truth. Carried by ordinary people who refused to let their faith be silenced.

title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
overview: Marcus, a customer service agent whose job is to help anyone with anything with the aid of Assist-O, a hyper-efficient AI assistant. When the tasks become increasingly bizarre and Assist-O starts taking things too far, Marcus struggles to maintain control, revealing the chaos and absurdity lurking behind the promise of perfect service.

title: Control
overview: A notorious kidnapper has struck again. While a girl was on her way home from school, the kidnapper managed to abduct her. Detective Lucas Fonck is investigating the case and is gathering information from various residents in the neighborhood where the girl lives.  His first interview takes place at the home of a man named Wout de Jonge, and during the interview, both men begin to realize that there is more to the other than meets the eye.

title: Wills Home Movies
overview: Home movies are immortal through moments frozen in time but also forever changing as our life evolves and our perspectives shift. The further you look back the harder it becomes to find what you once were, but home movies can act as a reminder of the pieces of your life that have made you what you are. This film is an honest snapshot of my life, but its core is rooted in universal life experiences that anyone can find glimpses of themselves in.

title: Madonna & Graham
overview: Graham Norton sits down with the 'Queen of Pop', singer-songwriter, record producer, actress, entrepreneur, charity founder and LGBT rights and gender equality activist Madonna. The pair discuss her lengthy career in which she has achieved 18 multi-platinum albums globally, seven Grammy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, twenty MTV Video Music Awards and an induction to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

title: Kill your Darlings
overview: Alan is presented with a unique opportunity by a mysterious woman. But what seems to be a satisfaction of his darkest desires escalates in a way he couldn’t have seen coming…

title: Salt
overview: “What do we say anymore to conjure the salt of our earth?”  400 meters under the surface in coastal Antrim, machinery and poetry echo out from the depths of Ireland's only active salt mine. Featuring and inspired by Seamus Heaney’s “The Singers House”, this short documentary takes a poetic view of the salt mine as both an artificial space and a natural environment, finding a sense of humanity in its alien sounds and structures.

title: Starflyer
overview: Niki and Aurora meet on a winter night at Allou Fun Park, the biggest theme park in Athens. Soon they will discover that they come from the same world.

title: Jia
overview: In the haze of a California summer, two best friends must reckon with their feelings for one another.

title: Naked
overview: “Naked” is a raw, intimate split-screen drama set inside a grand hotel. On a weekend away, young couple Nora and Simon are caught in the intoxicating rush of a new relationship. But when Simon accuses Nora of saying the wrong name in bed, a brief but crucial window opens: a chance for both of them to be honest. Physically close yet emotionally miles apart, each side of the screen follows their inner narrative as a quiet countdown begins.

title: The Dance of A Soloist
overview: Li Ze-yang's journey in music was bumpy yet full of colors. His musical collection serves as a historic witness to ethnic communities. His relentless editorial commitment proved a quintessential scarcity in the history of Taiwanese music.

title: Dave vs. Hollywood
overview: Dave is an actor who moves to Los Angeles, completely devoid of connections and contacts. The humiliations and indignities soon pile up. After a fruitless struggle, Dave decides to make his mark by taking a non-traditional, unorthodox, 'anything goes' approach — he joins AA for connections; joins Scientology to network; considers donating a kidney to an aging movie star in exchange for a role in said aging star’s film; leaves his headshot and reel on the windshields of vehicles outside the Brentwood church where a funeral for a studio executive is taking place, etc.

title: The Red Anorak
overview: An oracle in the Paris of May ’68 and the back of a stranger in a Madrid nightclub in the early 1990s. Interwoven stories bound by a gentle attraction, as though desire permeated everything and the only law was that of necessity.

title: Amid The Noise and Haste
overview: A trans woman seeks her true voice through vocal training while bracing to meet her boyfriend’s parents.

title: Let Us Be
overview: An intimate portrait of Intersex individuals born with sex anatomy not typically male or female, across India, Brazil, and the USA. Through personal stories, the film exposes the ongoing human rights struggle against non-consensual surgeries performed on intersex children, while confronting the rigid binaries that shape our understanding of sex and gender. "Let Us Be" invites audiences to reconsider the norms imposed on bodies and identities, offering a reflection on autonomy, dignity, and the beauty of human diversity.

title: Corps Man
overview: The untold true story of Mexican-American combat corpsman Dave Lara, and his band of brothers known as The Group, who kept the biggest secret of the Vietnam War. For the first time on film, Dave Lara tells his story of how he and The Group navigated a hostile society and military as gay men at a time when it was criminal to be themselves.

title: Hoppy Ending
overview: A cheerful Easter village, famous for its giant bunny mascots and pastel-colored egg hunts, hides a dark secret. Years ago, a corporate Easter mascot company mysteriously went bankrupt, and the mascots “disappeared” during the closing ceremony. Locals whisper about the “Hollow Hare,” a terrifying entity born from the mascots’ abandoned costumes and the children’s forgotten toys.

title: Зоопарк
overview: *Zoo* is a film about what happens when a person takes responsibility for another living being. It is about the people who choose this work—once—and stay forever. About animals that fell victim to inhumane treatment but were saved within the zoo. And about how the world increasingly needs places like this—places where every life is priceless.

title: Demon Hunter: Time 2 Kill
overview: On the hunt to find the pieces of a medallion that can end the demonic control over Earth, Taryn is forced to go through time to save the future.

title: Mitjyu
overview: A story about two guy bonded with the relationship 'Mitjyu' yet navigating through the complexities with each other.

title: Method Cowboy
overview: When a struggling actor feigns being gay to land the role of a lifetime in an Oscar-bait Cowboy Western, he decides to transform himself for the role, blurring the lines between reality and performance.

title: Cheer Dad
overview: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

title: Returning Home
overview: Clara reluctantly returns to her childhood to be with her sister, Alma, and help pack up their recently deceased mother's house. When a vase is accidently broken, the unsaid words between the two sisters come to the surface.

title: Ontari E-Kaki
overview: A lonely, unemployed young man seeks comfort online, only to find himself trapped in the very culture he once laughed at.

title: Sunlit
overview: What am I to myself?

title: Sh(Out)
overview: After 20 years of marriage, a 43-year-old mother takes to the open road, exploring her identity, quiet courage, and the longing to be seen—not just as a parent or partner, but as herself.

title: Spring Child
overview: In 1912 Australia, two girls hide a forbidden bond from their nature-worshipping cult, but when their secret is exposed, the fearsome Shepherd blames them for the land’s failing harvest.

title: The Bait
overview: Rosie and Annie’s love has always felt unshakable, but old tensions resurface with the disappearance of their cat Ripley. When Rosie is visited by a divine presence, she is compelled to undergo the ultimate test.

title: Staubwelt
overview: An elderly crime investigator has reached the end of her career. Shortly after stepping down, she encounters the Devil, who has appeared in the city and begun working as a police photographer. During a series of walks together, a warmth develops between them. Over the course of their conversations, the Devil reveals he needs her help to end his own existence.

title: XYZ
overview: An obsessive exploration of the three geometric dimensions in hopes of reaching a fourth.

title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

title: A Deadline Movie
overview: A group of college students travel back in time to submit their late assignment

title: Hangar
overview: A group of homosexual men lick, stamp, and dispatch their erotic fantasies through a surreal postal service in an intensely experimental film. Shot on Super 8, the piece unfolds as a rhythmic whirlwind in which desire circulates as physical matter.

title: Goners
overview: Two brothers at odds must learn to get along to survive their camping trip.

title: One word, not two
overview: In December of 2024, Hrvoje Turković sent Kino klub Osijek a notice – kinoklub is written as one word, not two.

title: Get to Work
overview: A man struggles in his bathroom through a severe panic attack as he desperately tries to work through it and get to work on time.

title: The Deliverer
overview: Facundo is an eccentric man with a variety of jobs and interests, but few people remember one of his greatest talents. After years of being sidelined in the industry, he receives a call with an offer he can’t refuse. He’ll become The Deliverer once again.

title: Far Far Away From LA
overview: Katie, from the United States, and La Coneja, from Argentina, break up after an intense relationship because neither of them was willing to emigrate to stay together. One night, Katie shows up unexpectedly to "end things on better terms."

title: Nowhere Coast
overview: a man visits his ex-lover who is suffering from symptoms of early onset dementia

title: Летом всякое бывает. Побег из Сколбора
overview: Eleven-year-old Zlata becomes overly engrossed in gaming during the holidays, ignoring her parents requests to clean up the dishes, review math homework, and walk the dog. Her father confiscates Zlata's gaming devices for the rest of the holidays. Zlata is deeply upset and, before going to bed, wishes, "To play forever, without any limits!" In the morning, Zlata's wish comes true, and she finds herself playing the game, but soon realizes that playing 24/7 isn't as exciting as she thought.

title: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
overview: Dudley is a teenage frog who lives a peaceful life by the edge of his pond with his friends, meanwhile his parents are worried about his future. But when aliens land on Earth, Dudley's world is thrown into chaos. What if he has what it takes to become a hero and save the whole of humanity?

title: Node
overview: A poignant exploration of childhood illness, resilience, and family.

title: Epiphany
overview: The power went out twice that night. Other things happened as well.

title: Meet Me at the Club: The Castro Country Club Story
overview: On April 1, 1983 at the frightening start of the AIDS epidemic, gay businessman and restaurateur Steve Harris opened the doors to the Castro Country Club as a refuge where folks could gather and find community outside of the bars and clubs in the Castro. For 40 years, the CCC has saved thousands of lives from the grips of addiction and alcoholism from its humble perch on 18th Street, one block from Castro Street. Meet Me at the Club captures the history of early trans experiences, the role that the AIDS epidemic played in addiction and alcoholism, and the miraculous recoveries from hopeless states of mind and body in San Francisco. When 295 people die every day from overdoses, the story of how this beautiful community came together to survive and thrive, there's no more important time than now to tell this story.

title: Enter
overview: Set against the backdrop of school memories and first love, ENTER explores the emotions we carry long after moments have passed. Through silence, longing and nostalgia, a young boy confronts the feelings he never expressed and discovers the courage to begin.

title: To Become Ghosts
overview: A group of communist militants debate becoming a clandestine organization at the beginning of a new wave of state repression.

title: Fires Of Katherine
overview: As she deals with the consequences of a near-death experience, Katherine finds herself stuck in limbo, piecing together her past lives while dealing with loneliness, isolation and trauma, finding solace in unusual places

title: P$RN STAR University
overview: What happens when one of OnlyFans’ biggest stars decides to open a university? Andy Lee is breaking taboos and building a business, one straight guy at a time. With fifteen years in the adult industry behind him, he’s now doing something nobody else has attempted: launching a real-life school for aspiring male performers, coaching, coaxing and filming straight-identifying men as they step into gay adult content for the first time. His new intake arrives with different motivations, quick cash, curiosity, ambition, or all three. What none of them expect is quite how much they’re about to learn, about performance, yes, but also about boundaries, identity and the surprisingly emotional experience of being truly seen.

title: Traces of What Remains
overview: Full of tenderness and love, Selma and Nori look forward to their first child together and a future as a family. But one morning, Nori finds himself confused and injured in the park, with no memory of the last few hours. The mysterious circumstances surrounding his amnesia and a miscarriage put their relationship to the test.

title: TAEMONG
overview: During a pregnancy photoshoot, a woman sells her taemong - a baby conception dream - which contains a dark desire triggered by her past.

title: Love in Old York
overview: A bored student, trapped in a black and white world finds unexpected colour, when he meets his true love.

title: Pauline
overview: In a bar, Pauline writes to a man she does not know. Between desire, art, and projection, reality eventually begins to crack the story she has invented for herself.

title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
overview: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

title: Le jour porte conseil
overview: Every night, a young man forgets the woman he loves. Every morning, she owes him relearning their story. For one other day, they experience love as intense as ephemeral, until even written memories start to disappear, only remains then, a love that continues to exist, despite forgetness.

title: Tip-top
overview: I did everything tip-top, a then...

title: Divinorum
overview: Paul returns to his workplace after being admitted to a rehabilitation clinic.

title: My Mother’s Story
overview: At the age of seventeen, Zahide is married off to a man fifteen years her senior. Within the sixth month of their marriage, her husband passes away, leaving her pregnant. A few months later, she gives birth to their child.Soon after, Zahide’s sister is also married—this time to the younger brother of Zahide’s late husband. When her sister, too, is widowed while carrying a child and already raising three others, Zahide is compelled, against her will, to marry the surviving brother of her deceased husband. Bound by the constraints of their time, the two sisters come to share not only the same household but also the same destiny.  Their lives unfold as a profound testimony to the harshest realities imposed upon women, where personal desire yields to societal pressure, and survival necessitates the surrender of choice. This narrative portrays the endurance of two sisters navigating an oppressive system, their shared sorrow echoing the struggles of countless women silenced by history.

title: No Contest
overview: When Victoire, a young trans judoka, reaches the final of a regional competition, her opponent, Sonia, refuses to compete against her.

title: Home-stay
overview: After spending the night in a cozy homestay, Quynh’s body grows weaker and weaker, to the point where she realizes she may no longer be able to leave this place.  Tokyo Lift-Off Award 2026 Winner for Best Acting Ensemble.

title: Breathe, Brother, Breathe
overview: An asthmatic Iranian-American high schooler learns the trumpet to keep a precious friendship intact, reconnect with his emotionally distant family, and take control of his fragmented life.

title: What Am I Looking At? Is It Someone’s Navel?
overview: While attempting to record life as it was, Arthur unintentionally documents his family’s unraveling.

title: About The Mother
overview: Sibel's husband is hospitalized with liver failure and is waiting for an organ transplant. Due to the urgency of the situation and the low probability of his turn, Sibel begins searching for an organ donor on her own.

title: The Gang
overview: Ayman, a teenager of Moroccan descent, is invited by Sara to a party at the same house where his mother works as a domestic worker. Along with Eric and Robert, his lifelong friends, they set off on a journey filled with confrontations and disappointments -with society and with themselves- putting their gang's friendship to the test. Once at the party, they discover that life isn't what they thought, and that wanting something doesn't always make it possible.

title: The Butcher and The Crabs
overview: As a war threatens mankind, a pair of roommates tries to outlive a few crabs that they had purchased for a party.

title: Blue Sands
overview: In a neon-drenched dystopia where lifespans are traded like currency, a dying man drags himself through the night in search of a second chance he may not deserve.

title: Bittersuite
overview: During a wedding at a hotel, Bety, a young receptionist, becomes intrigued by Vicki, a mysterious older guest. The night lures them to the pool, the tension builds, and everything ends with an unexpected disappearance.

title: Stuck
overview: Kamila has an epiphany about time spent at a place that makes her feel stuck.

title: Symbiosis
overview: A weekend reunion at an isolated house turns sinister when old friends realise their host, and the house itself, may want more than their company.

title: Last Stop for the Circular Ticket
overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

title: 50 Years of Punk
overview: This new documentary traces the explosion of punk on London’s Kings Road and is the most authentic insider account of punk’s evolution and legacy, by the artists and people who lived it. Fifty years on, punk’s core values of individuality, creativity, authenticity and freedom, are more relevant than ever. Punk was never about the music - it is a way of life. Features interviews and footage with Hugh Cornwell, Dave Vanian, Vivienne Westwood, Rat Scabies, Gaye Advert, Richard Jobson, Glen Mattlock, Jan Wobble, Terry Chimes, Tony James, Viv Albertine and many more.

title: The Velvet Viscera
overview: A Magician performs for her freaks in the circus when she looses control and finds something is living inside her. At an attempt to keep this creature away she comes face to face with her child only to end up in another womb.

title: Night of the Vamp-Friars
overview: A group of friends in a punk rock band discover a hidden cemetery in the woods where they accidentally raise a group of undead Friars.

title: 40 Wacks
overview: When a group of friends wander into a long abandoned home they soon discover that a evil spirit is among them.

title: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 - Part 6: Blue Labyrinth
overview: Part 6 of the theatrical version of the third Yamato remake show.

title: My Little Nothing
overview: Two voices, one written, the other synthesised, engage in a philosophical dialogue about the amorous abyss separating them: a nineteen-year-old girl has decided to marry the Devil.

title: Brotherhood of the Court: Beginning
overview: An intimate sports documentary drama showcasing the historic rise of the Slovenian men's national volleyball team from 64th in the world rankings to a global powerhouse. Through archival footage and previously unseen behind-the-scenes and locker-room moments, the film reveals the genuine relationships, defeats, and unwavering bond of the boys who became brothers on and off the court.

title: Abnormal business
overview: When a group of five teenagers, working for a paranormal investigating company, enter the haunted home of a random Dutch man, they realize the horrors of what they are about to face.

title: ULTRAVIOLETA
overview: In a crowded nightclub under violet lights, Avril can’t stop looking at Carla dancing across the room. When a drunk guy starts to make Carla uncomfortable, Avril steps in and that moment brings them together. After hiding out in the bathroom and helping each other out, the connection between them begins to grow.

title: The Hockey Player
overview: A documentary that follows Canadian-born defenseman Luke Prokop as he decides to become the first — and still only — professional athlete playing under contract to an NHL team to come out as gay. Growing up in Edmonton steeped in Canada’s tough, often homophobic hockey culture, and playing without gay role models throughout professional sports, Luke’s path to coming out of the closet has been neither easy nor obvious. The film charts Prokop’s personal journey against the backdrop of a professional hockey industry that has had, at best, an ambivalent relationship to diversity. As the film sensitively reveals, being publicly out certainly came as an earthquake to his family, especially his father Al, who as Luke’s mentor and sometime coach represents the most complex and moving relationship in the film.

title: Bloodlust
overview: Set in a post apocalyptic world, a man seeks revenge against a group of survivors.

title: JACKPOT!
overview: When a young man hides the truth about his lottery ticket winnings from his friend, conflict erupts.

title: Caussade le Film
overview: Beyond those never-ending fields where there's nothing but blazing sun and quiet nights, only thing reliable is the sky is blue, the grass is green and eyes are red.

title: Eat Me Stupid
overview: A singer song writer frustrated with her music wandered through the city of Darjeeling in search of inspiration.

title: Strangers in the Mountain
overview: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: The Matchmaker
overview: Amar is a creature of habit — quiet, solitary, and most at home among his matchboxes. So when a shy colleague at the match factory works up the courage to ask him out, his instinct isn’t to say yes. It isn’t even to say no. Instead, he decides to play matchmaker — steering her toward the charming regular at the village pub. A tidy solution. Except, of course, it isn’t.

title: Naxos
overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

title: If Only
overview: A story about being in many realities at once. Sometimes one at a time, sometimes all at once.

title: Uprising Smoke
overview: A film director. A protest against the 6x1 work schedule. And there is always this guiding, meditative voice that controls the impulse to revolt, that isolates, atomizes the being. In this confusion, it's necessary to choose a side - or at least be aware of the side chosen. There is no not choosing.

title: Tracing Paper
overview: Follow the preservation of vintage paper through past, present, and future.

title: Europiano (2/2)  - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
overview: In the second part of this magnificent concert celebrating music from across Europe, Lukas Sternath, Martha Argerich, Bruce Liu and Hayato Sumino perform the finest piano concertos by Beethoven, Schumann, Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

title: Exposure
overview: Desperate for money, a struggling photographer accepts a high-paying anonymous photoshoot in a stranger’s house.

title: Served Cold
overview: When the sacred code between two hitmen best friends is broken, revenge is the only option. Clyde tracks down his former colleague Mal – but his assassination attempt will be harder to execute than he first thought.

title: Scratch And Whine
overview: A desperate dog owner decides to take care of an old woman at a house in the middle of nowhere.

title: Little Nightmares - Broken Promises
overview: Locked in an attic, a neglected little girl escapes into a miniature world full of promise, until she discovers its terrible secrets: behind every shadow lurks a monster.

title: Transience
overview: Two homeless companions discover a magical hourglass with the power to rewind time… but only for ten seconds. They soon realise that this could be an opportunity to drastically change their situation. However, their plan requires two people, and neither one fully trusts the other.

title: The Pink Funeral
overview: A transgender Chinese girl on the brink of crossing over to the afterlife embarks on a comedic struggle back on Earth to ensure the proper burial of her body, ultimately leading to a profound reconciliation with her mother and acceptance of her true identity.

title: Phylum
overview: A wordless 16mm experimental short film exploring the human relationship to nature, labor, and the evolution of machinery.

title: Blankets
overview: A mother attempts to resurrect her dead husband with the help of her eleven year old son.

title: Schrödinger's Man
overview: In the midst of an existential crisis, Y. ostracizes himself to live the rest of his days in  solitude - locked in an underground bunker, with a system designed to euthanize him at a  random time.  Both dead and alive, his fragile peace is shattered by a series of apparitions.

title: Jaffa's Stories 2
overview: A sequel to the theatrical film "Jaffa's Stories", based on the books by Menachem Talmi and the TV show adaptation.

title: The War Game at Cinecity
overview: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: The Prince of Nanawa
overview: On a bustling footbridge separating Argentina and Paraguay, where people traffic all kinds of things in a mix of Guarani and Spanish, we meet Angel. Over the course of the next ten years, Angel will have to make decisive choices for his future.

title: Entroncamento
overview: In the town of Entroncamento, violence, misfortune, greed, and loyalty rule the streets. Laura arrives there to rebuild her life, but the irresistible pull of quick money and crime immediately draws her back into a troubled past. For those she meets at this crossroads, every day presents the choice between who they were and who they might become.

title: The Confession
overview: As a priest listens to a distraught woman’s confession, he begins to realise she’s after more than forgiveness.

title: American Heena
overview: As part of his wedding plans, Dudu needs to go back to Israel from America for a ritual Hina ceremony with his fiance's American family.

title: THE SCRIPT: A Semi-Satirical, Possibly Pretentious, Meta-Commentary Lamenting the Hopeful Pipe Dreams of Every Aspiring Movie Maker
overview: Aspiring auteur director John tries to get his overly ambitious script turned into a real film.

title: Esquecendo Cacá
overview: After ruining yet another friendship, Alina finds herself tormented by the fear of eternal loneliness and decides to try to reconnect with Cacá, the only girl she never fought with.

title: With Sympathy
overview: A grieving woman is bombarded with well-meaning advice she never asked for.

title: Maya Ko Dori Le
overview: A story of love, relationships, and the bonds that connect us all.

title: Mirage
overview: A young man searches the city at night for a woman and is led by her into an initiation ritual.

title: Gregor
overview: The discovery of a human skull fragment plunges Gregor into a hallucinatory thriller blending violence, power, and extreme fantasies...

title: Папа, купи песика
overview: Milana receives a long-awaited gift from her parents—a puppy named Dippy. Her joy knows no bounds, but one day, while out for a walk, the girl gets distracted, and the puppy gets lost in the park, left all alone to face the big city. Dippy meets a street cat and a rat named Bangs, and even falls in love with a Chihuahua named Tabby. While Milana searches for her beloved pup, exciting adventures await Dippy—adventures in which he must become a true hero, capable of protecting not only himself but also his friends.

title: Suite Dreams
overview: “Suite Dreams” is a three-episode fiction film set in hotel rooms that hold historical, social, and symbolic layers of Brazil. At Hotel Riazor (Rio de Janeiro), the story unfolds on the night of August 24, 1954, facing the windows of Catete Palace — when entering history can mean leaving life behind. Madeira Palace (São Paulo), a well-known downtown hotel associated with chemsex encounters, receives a character immersed in delirium and confinement, confronted with his own duplication. Freely inspired by Campos de Carvalho. At Hotel Glória (Rio de Janeiro), the rise of a new real estate icon unfolds — because even ghosts are forced to update themselves.

title: Eve
overview: While visiting her father's apartment, a woman discovers that the man who raised her might be something less than human.

title: How They Really Are
overview: A boy named Tyler Ortin is struggling with lonlieness and the problem of his parents constant fighting when he becomes friends with a classmate Louey. Tyler helps his class get their grades back on track but the stress catches up to him.

title: You're Just Tired
overview: Feeling isolated, lonely, and bored, new mother Lydia struggles to grasp what's real and what's her imagination.

title: METILNATOR I
overview: After a serious accident, Metil dies, but his brother decides to turn him into a cyborg. Following a psychotic episode, Metilnator kills his brother and embarks on a quest for revenge against an unexpected figure.

title: Coo Coo Quark Quark
overview: A group of young people born in or after 1995 from Hangzhou set out on a quest for a cherished item they lost in their childhood, a journey that unexpectedly changed their lives in the process.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: Do Stars Know Fear?
overview: Trapped operative confronts cunning foil amid tense, futuristic space hemisphere.

title: Kashmir 1947
overview: Kashmir 1947 vividly recounts the tumultuous events of 1947–48, drawing on firsthand testimonies, military perspectives, seldom-seen archives, and a captivating narrative. The documentary weaves together music, songs, and potent narration, presenting history in a way that resonates with modern viewers, even those of a younger generation.  "Kashmir 1947" is a documentary that educates, resonates, and stirs the soul. The film transforms history, crafting a compelling narrative that resonates with contemporary audiences.

title: Secondhand Spells
overview: After successfully casting a spell from a thrift-store grimoire, Alex and Riley realise they may have gotten more than they bargained for.

title: Пустые места
overview: A new feature-length narrative film by Nikita Miklushov.

title: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior
overview: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.

title: Bug Bite
overview: On a remote Australian farm, a weary farmer crosses paths with a wounded stranger desperate for help. What begins as an uneasy act of kindness quickly spirals into a nightmarish fight for survival, as something far more sinister than an injury reveals itself.

title: Aipocalypse
overview: Following a suspicious, near-miss doomsday event, an amateur astronomer and a stoned conspiracy theorist turn to Banterbot, an AI chatbot, for answers.

title: BREAKFAST AT BERGHAIN
overview: A small-town girl takes a pilgrimage to the famed German nightclub Berghain and ends up spending years of her life in the hallowed den of drum and bass.

title: Харон
overview: A new feature-length narrative film by Akim Salbiev.

title: The Hunter and The Hunted
overview: Two boys rustle the feathers of a ruthless hunter and find themselves in an intense chase that will test their teamwork and will to survive.

title: Fox & the Tiny Demon
overview: Qaqsoss naka Wahantuhsis is an animated allegory about Qaqsoss, a fox who is haunted by Wahantuhsis, a tiny demon. Set in an enchanted forest, the film explores themes of mental illness, trauma, and generational pain through Qaqsoss' struggles with both her inner demons and the mischievous demon that follows her. As Qaqsoss faces her fears, she discovers resilience and growth. Ultimately, the story intertwines Indigenous culture and personal experience, showcasing the importance of self-healing and the understanding of others. The film, told in Wolastoqey, is a poignant exploration of survival and connection.

title: La Plus Belle Fille du Monde
overview: Gabriel became friends with "the most beautiful girl in the world". Obsessed with her, he put aside all his convictions in the hope of pleasing her.

title: Aimless Monologue Before The Credits...
overview: A young man reflects on the past moments of his life just before everything changes forever.

title: 10s Across the Borders
overview: If the world doesn’t accept you and your kind, trailblaze a world that does. Inspired by the Black and  Latinx underground Ballroom culture of New York, Sun, Teddy, and Xyza create Ballroom communities in Southeast Asia as safe havens from homophobia, transphobia, color discrimination and HIV stigma.

title: Sobras de Arte: Estou-Me Nas Tintas
overview: When a game night turns into a challenge, Pedro decides to take matters into his own hands and find the right gallery for his paintings.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: The Pleasure Dome
overview: Ruan follows a strange man through the streets of downtown São Paulo into a public bathroom, where he begins an oniric journey of pleasure and discovery.

title: Noite Experimental
overview: Inca trepanations, bestiaries, the attempted sale of the Parque Lage land for the construction of a cemetery, and Pinscher and Yorkshire Terrier clubs are some of the events we witness here, in these three fictional projects for the historic mansion in the Botanical Garden: the Carioca Shangri-La, the Giza Necropolis, and Machu Picchu. The video was made in the context of the course Archive, Montage and Memory, developed from images from the collection of the Visual Arts School of Parque Lage, Memória Lage.

title: Ultimate Racer
overview: As graduation approaches, two students at a prestigious racing academy must come to terms with what may be their final race together and the end of their rivalry.

title: THE CAGE WITHIN
overview: A true fight isn’t fought in the ring, but inside the mind.  The Cage Within follows Jake, a young fighter struggling with anger, trauma and the weight of expectations, as he tries to break the cycle of violence that shaped him. Between training, silence and fractured relationships, the film observes a man who chooses not to become what hurt him — even when that choice hurts more.  An intimate, restrained drama about masculinity, control and the quiet cost of change.

title: Action Stage: Helios Rising Heroes -New Dawn-
overview: Four years have passed since the "Lost Zero" incident.  Keith Max still believes in the survival of Dino Albani, who was presumed dead, and continues to pursue him.  Meanwhile, Brad Beams keeps a close eye on Keith's precarious actions, striving to find answers to his own doubts.  At this time, a new "Eclipse" threat creeps into the city.  In the midst of this chaotic situation, standing before the "Heroes" is "Zero," with whom they have fought countless times.  As they confront each other once again, the lost time begins to move violently once more.

title: The Brutal Alchemy of Water
overview: Refusing to accept the loss of her girlfriend, Quinn spirals through the suffocating confines of prison. In the depths of her grief she must navigate her unraveling mind and confront her inner demons.

title: From ruin, we rise
overview: Bridging the devastation of the Masara landslide and the environmental transformation of Barangay Mapaang, the documentary tells a story of loss, renewal, and the power of communities to shape their own future.

title: The Shark Next Door
overview: When global warming forced sharks to develop motor skills to survive amongst humans, Elliot, a kind-hearted young man, falls in love with Finn, a brooding and solitary shark

title: ave HRUBÁ
overview: Poet, performer, and local legend Eva Hrubá is a woman of contradictions, sparking both devotion and public outcry. This documentary dives into her dual existence of vibrant joy and silent suffering. Moving beyond her reputation as the  "eccentric lady on a purple bike," the film explores how she transforms loneliness into art and pain into a shared celebration of life. The film explores the world of a remarkable woman, seeking the boundary between her persona as an author and her performance.

title: Polymer
overview: A cuck smokes a cigarette backwards while a failed rapper reminisces on his downfall. They come to realize a startling existential truth.

title: The Prayer of The Rose
overview: An emotional journey of a teenage boy asking God to liberate him from his self-inflicted downfall.

title: Safe In My Skin
overview: Mikey Liu, a young Chinese American man living in New York City, travels to his hometown for the funeral of his childhood friend, Shaun. As the trip pulls him back into his past, long-buried memories begin to surface, revealing the quiet weight of a complicated friendship.

title: In Search of Stolen Time
overview: «Time is money» is an oft-repeated expression in our modern performance-oriented society. But how does it affect us as individuals, and influence our society? Director Konrad Wakolbinger deconstructs this common and unquestioned concept, and shows, with subtle humor, how our understanding of time, work, and their interdependence has changed over the centuries.

title: iHostage
overview: Abducted from her idyllic paradise and drugged, Ranger Jane Winter must escape her bonds or risk being caught in a predator's unforgiving web forever.

title: Jeongbaengi
overview: In July 2024, record-breaking rains caused the levee to collapse, swallowing Jeongbaengi Village in an instant. Amid the ruins and cold bureaucracy, residents endure their hardships by relying on one another. Cooking meals together in the mud, they begin a journey of recovery. Can the resilience of a community, born from disaster, rebuild lives swept away by the current?

title: The Day I Stopped Walking
overview: When we stop we're so focused on productivity and efficiency that we feel guilty and confused about our own limitless time giving rise to a silent restlessness: the feeling that we should be producing, moving forward, and justifying every minute. With a new emerging force, the human being in its essence becomes increasingly scarce: we can no longer think, speak, and, above all, be. But ultimately, why does it have to be this way?

title: Wish You Were Here
overview: Gray recalls a memory of him and his ex, Sybil, arguing. Only to be dragged back to the cold empty present.

title: Baba
overview: Gourab, a journalist raised in an orphanage, dreams of becoming the perfect father more than a successful reporter. But when a dangerous child trafficking racket terrorizes Kolkata, he is forced to balance his duties as a husband, father, and journalist while risking everything to protect innocent children and uncover the truth.

title: The Vacation Begins
overview: The beginning of summer. Yuka, who has just divorced Haruki after three years of marriage, goes on vacation to a seaside town with her best friend Shina and her boyfriend Dazai. Reunited with Dazai, who she was once in love with, after a long time, Yuka's feelings for him gradually begin to rekindle. Meanwhile, Shina is attracted to Tenma, a poet who lives in the seaside town. Unrequited feelings and a peaceful daily life. The vacation has only just begun.

title: Natural Balance
overview: A film student obsessed with making a movie about loneliness grabs his camera and sets out chasing old men. It seems he finally manages to catch up with one of them.

title: Ghatak Was Here
overview: A personal essay film about the life, death and resurrection of the great Bengali director Ritwik Ghatak

title: So Be It
overview: Five senior LGBTQIA+ couples share their resilient love stories, reflecting on identity, aging, and love while offering younger generations inspiring role models.

title: If We Ever Make It To Someday
overview: Law student Cassian, can't seem to let go of his high school sweetheart, Victoria, who seems to have moved on without him. And there's this mystery girl that lingers in his mind like perfume in an old house. With the pressure of the future and the state of the world weighing heavily on him, how will Cassian confront everything he's trying to run from?

title: The Collected Pieces of Eleanor Ross
overview: Unsatisfied with her prospects following graduation, struggling artist Eleanor "Nell" Ross reflects on her life with her boyfriend over a game of dominoes.

title: Kung Fu Western
overview: In the midst of the Australian gold rush, a parched Chinese Traveller enters an isolated bar, but is refused service by a familiar face that sets him on a path of vengeance.

title: Unacceptable
overview: A drama based on a true story that spans decades, exploring themes of love, friendship, courage, and societal change. The story begins in 1981 with Ted, a frail elderly man, reflecting on his life as he celebrates a landmark legal ruling with his nephew Simon, Simon’s partner Mark, and his lifelong friend Catherine. Flashbacks reveal Ted’s youth in 1940s Melbourne, where he stood up against homophobia and violence, forming a complex bond with Catherine and Leo.

title: Source Connection
overview: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

title: Headphones
overview: As seen at Fantaspoa (2026), BIFFF (2026), St Kilda Film Festival (2026), deadCenter Film Festival (2026) & Chattanooga Film Fest (2026).  St Kilda Film Festival Award Winner of Best Achievement in Sound Post-Production & Best Achievement in Production Design.  A lovelorn young man working the late shift at a dead-end fast-food joint alongside his crush listens to his uncle's old Walkman, when a mysterious voice crackles through the headphones whispering exactly what he must do to keep her alive.

title: Creeping, Weaved Farms
overview: Series of Collision weaved together to form Adam.

title: The Errand
overview: An ordinary errand gives way to obsession and unease as a man finds himself caught between the rhythms of the city.

title: PAN DE AJO
overview: Victor, a shy and anxious guy, goes to Gabriel's apartment for the money he owes him. When he opens the door to Gabriel's room he will find nothing but horror...

title: 'Mr. Paradise'
overview: Rejected by the person he changed for, Tyler Terry, a picture-perfect boy must become who he truly is after losing himself to being someone else's paradise.

title: The Perfect Shot
overview: A hit man and photographer meet in a bar and discover they're both in town to shoot the president.

title: Tropical SOV: Bizarre Sci-fi Samba
overview: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

title: Solitaire
overview: A young woman adjusts to life in a new city, managing remote work, a relationship on thin ice, and single-player tennis.

title: Chuckle Chuckle
overview: Aiming to become comedians, Sahara and his comedy partner Setoguchi work together on their act, "Ultrasweet Sourpork", until unfortunate circumstances lead to their disbandment. Hindered by roadblocks on the path to success, Sahara suddenly encounters an "ideal" version of himself—an ultra-famous comedian. Boasting rich knowledge for success as a comedian, this "ideal" Sahara begins meddling with the real Sahara's life.

title: Gainesville Takes to the Streets
overview: A docu short film captured at the "No Kings" protests in Gainesville, GA.

title: The Intimacy Coordinator
overview: A heartbroken man mistakes an intimacy coordinator job posting as a sexual opportunity and is hired by two unhinged theater directors who believe they’ve found the perfect guy for the job.

title: Chronically Yours
overview: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

title: Vertical Remains
overview: Time ascends as history sinks. Thirty-two upward-tilting shots, across British Columbia’s Lower Mainland, excavate histories of Indigenous presence, colonial violence, and ecological transformation. As image fades from colour to monochrome and sound descends against the camera’s rise, chronology collapses. Archival images, composite landscapes, and a descending sonic register unsettle linear narration, reframing the present as accumulated residue, and the land emerges as an unresolved stratigraphic archive, where history persists vertically beneath contemporary space.

title: I’d Rather Be a Concorde
overview: An immigrant saying "Hello" to unknown lands. A recreation of old fantasy video games through irony, in which the protagonist and his Wizard guide companion, face strange situations that allude to the absurd nature of the immigrant's journey.

title: What the… Hen?
overview: A documentary about art, resistance, and an unusual friendship born in the shadow of war. Creating a gigantichen as a form of protest, an artistand his assistant unexpectedly forge a friendship that leads them onto pup-petry festival stages all over Europe.

title: The Faggots & Their Friends Between Revolutions
overview: A poetic cinematic envisioning of the legendary queer 1970s manifesto, The F--gots & Their Friends Between Revolutions, this visual meditation constrasts nature’s quiet strength with the rigid architecture of power. In a world where the f--gots and their friends are made of flowers, trees and softness, will they survive against the men of concrete and steel? A story of otherness not as weakness, but as enduring, blooming power.

title: Is There Life On Mars?
overview: March, 2028. A TV host who rebels against his superiors returns to the village where he spent his childhood with his brother, only to find even greater evil there.

title: Three Wishes
overview: While cleaning out his grandmother's living room, a young man discovers a mysterious lamp and accidentally frees the spirit of an eccentric genie,

title: The Third Child
overview: In a century where humanity has lost its way and boundaries no longer exist, a mother transforms her grief into a final act of hope and resistance.

title: 犀牛
overview: The day before their wedding, she told him she didn’t want children and may never will. The Rhino follows their marriage 11 years later, exploring how this conflict shapes their relationship.
